name: verify both hosts after feature removal
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && echo "--- NIXPC ---" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -4 && echo "--- ASAHI ---" && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.ASAHI.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -3 && echo "--- homeManagerModules sanity (stremioKai gone, others present) ---" && nix eval --impure --json .#homeManagerModules --apply 'm: builtins.attrNames m' 2>&1 | grep -v 'saved setting' | tail -2
